chunks: 3493 - He said: And I asked him about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
And give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given you.

He said: I heard my father عليه السلام say: He should not make the contract of emancipation with him upon the amount he intended, then increase it for him, and then reduce from it; rather, he should reduce from what he had intended to contract him upon.

key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the statement of Allah cited for explanation
key_terms.مَالِ اللَّهِ: the wealth of Allah, meaning wealth granted by Allah to people
key_terms.وَآتُوهُمْ: give them; an instruction to provide financial concession or support
key_terms.يَزِيدُ عَلَيْهِ: to increase the amount beyond what was intended
key_terms.يَضَعُ عَنْهُ: to remit or reduce part of the obligation
key_terms.يُكَاتِبْهُ: to enter into a mukataba, a contract of emancipation

ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام explain the verse "And give them from the wealth of Allah which He has given you" regarding mukataba?
ai.summary: This narration explains the verse as applying to the contract of manumission, instructing fairness in the amount set for a mukatab. The reduction should be genuine and taken from the amount originally intended, not by first inflating the sum and then pretending to grant a concession.
